facts.fact: Regulation 20 of Legal Notice 77 of 2025, gazetted and commenced 11 April 2025, makes the state Digital Health Agency responsible for maintaining the Health Management Information Services Platform for reporting, with a public portal of aggregate health data, routine reporting in its minimum data set, and an offence for a health data controller that fails to submit reports.

Regulation 19 of Legal Notice 77 of 2025, gazetted and commenced 11 April 2025, makes the state Digital Health Agency responsible for the day-to-day management of the shared health record, defined as the single source of reference for patients' medical history and a longitudinal record of every encounter, which certified digital health solutions must query and update within twenty-four hours of each encounter.
